name: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A.
summary: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a construction company in Chile and Peru. It offers building and civil works, including residential projects, office buildings, hotels, and retail projects, as well as public and private infrastructure projects; and construction and industrial assembly of highly complex heavy structures, and turnkey projects. The company also offers earthmoving projects, mechanical maintenance, and specialized services; and engages in real estate business.
